simple.meaning: הֶפֶךְ (hephek) is a Hebrew word meaning “a turn , i.e. the reverse.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: הֶפֶךְ (H2016) appears 2 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Ezekiel 16:34, with occurrences in Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to הֶפֶךְ (H2016) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in הֶפֶךְ (H2016) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: הֶפֶךְ (hephek) / H2016 is traced through Ezekiel 16:34 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H2016. hephek הֶ֫פֶךְ noun masculine the contrary, contrariness, perversity ; — absolute ׳ה Ezek 16:34 ; הֶ֑פֶךְ 16:34 ; suffix הַפְכְּכֶם Isa 29:16 (see Baer); — 1 the contrary, opposite thing מִןהַֿנָּשִׁים הֶפֶךְ וַיְהִיבָֿךְ Ezek 16:34 & there hath occurred in thee the contrary from other women ; 16:34 לְהֶ֑פֶךְ וַתְּהִי so thou hast become the contrary. 2 הַפְכְּכֶם Isa 29:16 Oh, your perversity !

occurrences.englishText: You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas you give hire, and no hire is given to you, therefore you are different.” ’
